Package com.lemarketjames.reports.insight

Class ActiveClientTrendController

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.reports.insight.ActiveClientTrendController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/reports/insights") public class ActiveClientTrendController extends Object
The active-client trend for analysts. Access needs no code here: every path under /api/v1/reports/ is ANALYST-only in SecurityConfig (contract C7). Kept apart from VolumeInsightController so each controller has one insight to serve.
